caption: The drawing features a highly detailed depiction of a lidded tankard, rendered in shades of gray on a beige background. The tankard dominates the left side of the composition, displaying a large curved handle, a hinged lid with a decorative thumb piece, and a heart-shaped tag attached to the handle that reads “T ASH.” On the upper right, there is an illustration of a heraldic coat of arms consisting of a shield with various symbols, flanked by leafy branches and topped with a lion holding a staff. Below and to the right of the large tankard, there is a smaller, simplified profile outline of the same tankard. Fine stippling and cross-hatching techniques are used to create shading and texture throughout the drawing, which is executed entirely in graphite or pencil. The composition is enclosed within a single rectangular line that frames the artwork, and the artist’s signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Tankard
